settings.title: Booking alerts
settings.lead: Choose how we tell you about a new booking or a cancellation. You can turn on more than one.
settings.instantOnText: We tell you about every booking by {channels}.
settings.instantOff: Instant booking is off for now

email.outbox: In this test version, emails stay in the site's email outbox.
email.noEmail: Your account has no email address yet.
email.failing: Our emails to <address></address> bounce, so email alerts are paused.
email.failingHint: They start again when an email to you arrives, or when you change the address.
email.notConfigured: The site's email service isn't connected yet.

telegram.notConfigured: The Bayit bot on Telegram isn't ready yet. Soon you'll be able to connect it here.
telegram.intro: Connect once: open the Bayit bot in Telegram and tap Start.
telegram.waiting: Waiting for you to tap Start in Telegram…
telegram.off: Connected, but Telegram alerts are off.
telegram.failing: Telegram doesn't accept our messages (maybe the bot was blocked). Open the bot and tap Start, or connect again.

push.intro: A pop-up on your phone or computer. It can't confirm that you saw it, so on its own it isn't enough for instant booking.
push.notConfigured: Notifications aren't set up on the site yet.
push.iphone: On iPhone: first add the site to your Home Screen (Share, then Add to Home Screen), open it from there and turn notifications on here.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked in this browser. Allow them in the browser's site settings, then try again.
push.devices: {count, plural, one {On for {count} device:} other {On for {count} devices:}}
push.enabledToast: Notifications are on for this device.
push.disabledToast: Notifications are off for this device.
push.failed: Couldn't turn notifications on. Please try again.

settings.later: SMS and WhatsApp alerts are planned as paid options.
settings.testNone: No channel is on yet, so there's nothing to test.
settings.guestsNote: Guests can still contact you every way you chose in the contact step of your listing.

reason.email_not_configured: The site isn't connected to an email service yet, so we can't confirm that you get every booking.{telegram, select, yes { Connect Telegram to take instant bookings now.} other {}} Until then, guests ask you directly (Ask the host).
reason.no_email: We need an email address to tell you about every booking.{telegram, select, yes { Add one, or connect Telegram.} other { Add one in your settings.}} Until then, guests ask you directly (Ask the host).
reason.email_failing: Our emails to <address></address> bounce.{telegram, select, yes { Change to an address that works, or connect Telegram.} other { Change to an address that works.}} Until then, guests ask you directly (Ask the host).
reason.telegram_failing: Telegram doesn't accept our messages (maybe the bot was blocked). Connect it again or turn on email alerts. Until then, guests ask you directly (Ask the host).
reason.no_channel: No alert channel that confirms delivery is on.{telegram, select, yes { Turn on email or connect Telegram.} other { Turn on email alerts.}} Browser notifications alone aren't enough. Until then, guests ask you directly (Ask the host).

notice.offTitle: Instant booking is off for now
notice.hotelTitle: Instant booking for hotels is coming soon
notice.hotelBody: We're building booking by room type, so that one booking never blocks the whole hotel. Until then guests contact you directly, and the check-in and check-out times and rules you fill in here show on your listing.

errors.telegram_not_configured: Telegram isn't set up on the site yet.
errors.push_not_configured: Notifications aren't set up on the site yet.

test.text: {brand}: this is a test alert. This is how we'll tell you about new bookings and cancellations. Settings: {url}
test.title: Test alert from {brand}
test.body: This is how we'll tell you about new bookings and cancellations.

paused.title: {brand}: an alert channel is paused
paused.email: {brand}: our emails to you bounce, so email alerts are paused.
paused.telegram: {brand}: Telegram doesn't accept our messages, so Telegram alerts are paused.
paused.stillInstant: Instant bookings continue: we alert you on your other channels.
paused.contactOnly: Until email or Telegram works again, guests ask you directly instead of booking instantly.

telegram.linked: Connected! {brand} will send you new bookings and cancellations here. To stop, send /stop or disconnect in your settings: {url}
telegram.expired: This link has expired or was already used. In {brand}, open Settings → Booking alerts and tap “Connect Telegram” again: {url}
telegram.help: This is the {brand} booking alerts bot. Connect it from your account settings: {url}
telegram.stopped: Disconnected. {brand} won't send alerts here any more. You can connect again from your settings: {url}
telegram.notLinked: This chat isn't connected to a {brand} account. Connect it from your account settings: {url}
telegram.resumed: Telegram alerts from {brand} are back on.
telegram.disconnected: You disconnected Telegram in your {brand} settings. You won't get alerts here any more.

save.sheetLead: We'll email you when new places match this search, at most once a day. You can pause or delete it at any time.
save.savedHint: We'll email you when new places are listed.
save.savedOffHint: Emails for saved searches are off. You can turn them on in Alerts.

errors.too_many_searches: You can save up to 20 searches. Delete one in Alerts to save a new one.
errors.failed: We couldn't save the search. Please try again.

page.metaDescription: Emails about new places for your saved searches and price drops of places you saved.
page.title: Alerts and saved searches
page.lead: Emails about new places for the searches you saved, and when a place you saved lowers its price.

emails.title: Emails

savedSearches.label: New places for my saved searches
savedSearches.hint: At most one email a day, in the morning. Never on Shabbat or Jewish holidays.

priceDrops.label: Price drops of places I saved
priceDrops.hint: When a place in your lists lowers its price by 3% or more.

emails.watching: {count, plural, =0 {No saved places yet.} one {Watching 1 saved place.} other {Watching {countText} saved places.}}
emails.noEmail: To get these emails, add an email address to your account.
emails.failing: Emails to your address are paused because an earlier email didn't arrive. Check the address in Settings.
emails.failed: We couldn't save that. Please try again.

searches.title: Saved searches
searches.limit: You can save up to {max} searches.
searches.emptyBody: Search for a place, then tap “Save search”. We'll email you when new places match.
searches.datesPassed: The dates of this search have passed, so we don't email about it. Open it, choose new dates and save it again.
searches.deleteBody: “{name}” will be deleted and you won't get emails about it any more.
searches.paused: Search paused. No emails about it.
searches.resumed: Search on again. We'll email you about places listed from now on.
searches.offNotice: Emails for saved searches are off, so nothing is sent.

errors.not_found: We couldn't find this search. It may have been deleted.
errors.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

quick.label: Saved searches
quick.hint: {count, plural, =0 {Emails about new places} one {1 active search} other {{countText} active searches}}

savedSearch.metaDescription: Stop or restart the emails about new places for your saved searches.

confirm.title: Stop saved-search emails?
confirm.body: We won't email you about new places for your saved searches any more. Your searches stay saved in your account.

alreadyOff.title: Saved-search emails are already off
alreadyOff.body: You can turn them back on here or on the Alerts page of your account.

off.title: Saved-search emails are off
off.body: We won't send you these emails any more. You can turn them back on at any time, here or on the Alerts page of your account.

on.title: Saved-search emails are back on
on.body: We'll email you when new places are listed, at most once a day.

invalid.title: This link doesn't work
invalid.body: The link may be cut off, or the account was deleted. You can choose which emails you get on the Alerts page of your account.

limited.title: Too many tries
limited.body: Try again in an hour, or change the setting on the Alerts page of your account.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: We couldn't save the change. Please try again in a moment.

priceDrop.metaDescription: Stop or restart the emails about price drops of places you saved.

confirm.title: Stop price-drop emails?
confirm.body: We won't email you any more when a place you saved lowers its price. Your lists stay as they are.

alreadyOff.title: Price-drop emails are already off
alreadyOff.body: You can turn them back on here or on the Alerts page of your account.

off.title: Price-drop emails are off
off.body: We won't send you these emails any more. You can turn them back on at any time, here or on the Alerts page of your account.

on.title: Price-drop emails are back on
on.body: We'll email you when a place you saved lowers its price by 3% or more.

invalid.title: This link doesn't work
invalid.body: The link may be cut off, or the account was deleted. You can choose which emails you get on the Alerts page of your account.

limited.title: Too many tries
limited.body: Try again in an hour, or change the setting on the Alerts page of your account.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: We couldn't save the change. Please try again in a moment.
